metadata.title: Perturbations of Intermediate-mass Black Holes on Stellar Orbits in the Galactic Center

notes: No star qualifies. S111 is only described as "appears to be unbound" in the context of its Keplerian orbit about the SMBH (T:p2-b4); the paper does not establish that S111 is unbound from the Milky Way. The simulated S-star sample is explicitly a population bound to the SMBH (T:p1-b4, T:p2-b4), and the generic discussion of future ejections and hypervelocity-star production (T:p6-b4) does not identify a named star as a present-day Galactic unbound candidate.
